collection.title: Dacia Duster 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Dacia Duster 2018 Onwards requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Dacia Duster which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
